title: MCMC Can See Can't See
abstract: arXiv:2610.20020v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: It is folklore that passing "convergence" diagnostics does not guarantee that a Markov chain has converged. We prove this as an impossibility for any finite checklist of diagnostics. Running more chains, longer chains, and smarter diagnostics does not avoid this impossibility in certifying convergence. Under regularity assumptions, we determine how the worst-case undetected non-convergence decays as more diagnostics are added, and how to choose diagnostics optimally. Folklore suggests that the sampler's slowest mixing modes are the "dangerous" ones that must be monitored; we prove that the slow modes yield nearly optimal diagnostics as sampling proceeds. Given a source class, we also give an anytime-valid bound on the remaining discrepancy and show how undetected bias caps the effective sample size that a finite checklist can certify.

translated_title: MCMC 能看见的与看不见的
translated_abstract: 众所周知，通过“收敛性”诊断并不能保证马尔可夫链已经收敛。我们证明了这一点对于任何有限的诊断清单而言都是一种不可能性。运行更多的链、更长的链以及更聪明的诊断方法，都无法避免在认证收敛时的这种不可能性。在正则性假设下，我们确定了随着加入更多诊断方法，最坏情况下未被检测到的未收敛性如何衰减，以及如何最优地选择诊断方法。民间观点认为，采样器混合最慢的模式是需要监测的“危险”模式；我们证明了随着采样的进行，慢模式能产生近乎最优的诊断。对于给定的源类别，我们还给出了剩余差异的任意时刻有效界限，并展示了未被检测到的偏差如何限制有限诊断清单所能认证的有效样本量。
tldr: 本文证明了任何有限的收敛诊断清单都无法保证MCMC真正收敛，并定量刻画了最坏情况下未被检测到的未收敛性如何随诊断方法增加而衰减、如何最优选择诊断方法，以及未被检测到的偏差如何限制有限诊断所能认证的有效样本量。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that no finite checklist of MCMC convergence diagnostics can certify convergence, and quantifies how worst-case undetected non-convergence decays as diagnostics are added, how to choose diagnostics optimally, and how undetected bias caps the certifiable effective sample size.
